name: Pipistrel Panthera
summary: Slovenian all-composite four-seat cruiser with a slender high-efficiency wing, retractable gear and a big canopy.

wings: Long, slender low wing with no struts
Wing sits low on a slim fuselage
engines: Single Lycoming IO-390 flat-four in a slim cowl
fuselage: Slippery all-composite fuselage with a large canopy
tail: Small, clean tail surfaces on a slender tail cone

tellTales: Slippery all-composite four-seat low-wing with a long slender wing
Sleek cowl with no struts or fixed gear

confusedWith.howToTell: The SR20/22 has fixed gear and a parachute hatch on the roof; the Panthera has retractable gear and a long slender wing.
The DA40 has a T-tail and fixed gear; the Panthera has retractable gear and a conventional tail.
The Mooney has a forward-raked fin and a smaller cabin; the Panthera has a long slender wing and a sleeker composite fuselage.
